content.short: Dual Finance provides incentive liquidity infrastructure for Web3 communities.
content.description: Dual Finance helps communities earn yield and generate value from their treasuries. By offering liquid option-based incentives, it unlocks value and boosts participation in decentralized ecosystems. The system features a token incentive mechanism designed to build allegiance and deter token dumping. The DUAL token is distributed fully and fairly through staking options that partner projects deploy to better incentivize their own communities, aligning incentives across treasuries and participants.
